output.attribution_rationale: The trial compared an integrated LLM, VR, CBT, and human-supervision package with face-to-face CBT and minimal support, without isolating the LLM.

achieved_dates.note: The entry has no achieved dates; the paper reports study duration but no calendar dates for recruitment or intervention.

conflict.note: No vendor funding, employment, equity, patent, or licence is disclosed; the entry describes public funding and the authors' development of the system.

output.summary: The paper supports a 60-participant randomized trial showing greater anxiety reduction with the integrated package than minimal support, but does not establish equivalence to face-to-face CBT. No evidence grade fits the supplied vocabulary because this small RCT lacked prospective registration; benefit dates and window placement remain unknown.
